pkgmetadata.longdescription: The QRTR (QIPCRTR) address family is the IPC router used on Qualcomm platforms to talk between the application processor and the remote processors, such as the modem, the DSPs and the sensor hub. This is the reference userspace implementation: libqrtr wraps the socket interface and the QMI message framing, qrtr-lookup lists the services currently registered and qrtr-cfg configures the local node and port. The name service mapping service names to node and port pairs is provided by the kernel itself since Linux 5.7 (net/qrtr/ns.c, built with CONFIG_QRTR), so the older userspace qrtr-ns daemon is not built here.
